text: Let's consider the set of three vectors in $\real^3$: $$ \vvec_1 = \threevec220,~~~ \vvec_2 = \threevec11{-1},~~~ \vvec_3 = \threevec{-1}01. $$ Forming the associated matrix gives $$ \begin{bmatrix}\vvec_1\amp\vvec_2\amp\vvec_3\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \amp 1 \amp -1 \\ 2 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp -1 \amp 1 \\ \end{bmatrix} \sim \begin{bmatrix} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \\ \end{bmatrix}. $$ Because there is a pivot position in every row, [prop-pivot-row] tells us that $\laspan{\vvec_1, \vvec_2, \vvec_3} = \real^3$.
